name: orbit-local
description: Explore, baixe e execute projetos do GitHub em um app local.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-client.mjs --check && node --check server.mjs && node --check lib/runner.mjs && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/release-notifications.js && node --check public/apoio.js && node --check desktop/main.mjs && node --check desktop/preload.cjs && node --check desktop/worker.cjs && node --check desktop/update.mjs && node --check electron-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --linux --x64 --publish never

author: Orbit
